system.description:
As part of casting a Jutsu, until the beginning of your next turn, you gain a fly speed equal to your movement speed. Additionally, you ignore effects that would force you to spend additional movement to move through a space, such as difficult terrain.

If a Hostile creature would reduce your speed as a result of a jutsu they cast, you can also use this Transformation to gain additional speed equal to the speed you lost until the end of your next turn.
